definitions.gloss: splitting evenly; dividing in half; going halves
definitions.explanation: Dividing something, typically a cost or expense, equally between two parties. Very commonly used when splitting a bill or sharing expenses.

examples.japanese: {費用|ひよう}を{折半|せっぱん}する。
examples.english: We split the cost in half.

examples.japanese: {家賃|やちん}はルームメイトと{折半|せっぱん}している。
examples.english: I split the rent with my roommate.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}の{交通費|こうつうひ}は{二人|ふたり}で{折半|せっぱん}することにした。
examples.english: We decided to split the travel expenses between the two of us.

notes:
Literally 'breaking in half.' {折半|せっぱん} always implies an exact 50-50 split between two parties.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {費用|ひよう}を{折半|せっぱん}する: to split the cost
- {家賃|やちん}を{折半|せっぱん}する: to split the rent
- ～と{折半|せっぱん}する: to go halves with someone

CONTRAST WITH {割|わ}り{勘|かん}:
- {折半|せっぱん}: general term for splitting any expense equally (rent, travel, project costs)
- {割|わ}り{勘|かん}: specifically splitting a restaurant or drinking bill among a group (can be more than two people)

USAGE:
Common in both casual and business contexts. Often used for recurring shared expenses like rent or utilities, not just one-time payments.
